title: Nircraft
description: Nircraft is a unique leveling SMP where doing basically anything (like mining, killing monsters, exploring, and so much more) will get you XP to level up and progress through the game.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9657e9f84d10b6110c5efb94a8a63ae31b985ba1.png)
Nircraft is a unique leveling SMP where doing basically anything (like mining, killing monsters, exploring, and so much more) will get you XP to level up and progress through the game. Players can collect items, find NPCs in the overworld for quests, claim more land as you level, and even participate in events that give awesome rewards! We also have top quality anticheat and staff that are willing to help out anytime. We are super welcoming, join in and become the next best player!
